records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Aisha,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

draft.subject: Next step after your Wrenfield kickoff
draft.body:
Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the getting started call last week — good to see your first project already up in Wrenfield. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding the first few tasks to that project is usually the natural next step.

If it's useful, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and walk through that with you, or answer anything that came up after the call.

Best,
Chidi
